## Summary

- Scheduled Tasks: optional start time, cron expression validation and preview, a cadence description, and recent job runs shown per schedule.
- Time zones: a site-wide schedule time zone, with per-user display time zone handling.
- Catalog embedding now runs as a managed schedule with its own jobs.
- Entity: Entity Data API, inbound references, and reworked publishing and version handling.
- Structure refresh keeps a unified catalog and persists Structure Diff results.
- Dictionaries: list API and UI can filter by status.
- Model Services: configurable client timeout (`timeout_sec`, default 30 seconds).
- Console sessions use an idle timeout in addition to the absolute lifetime; OpenAPI configuration and security handling were improved.

## Operator notes

- Back up Postgres before upgrading. Migrations 0044-0048 run automatically on API start.
- All users must sign in again once after the upgrade (session change).
- Before upgrading, confirm scheduled task cron time zones resolve to a single value. Migration 0046 fails otherwise. Check with:
  `SELECT DISTINCT schedule_timezone FROM scheduled_tasks WHERE cron IS NOT NULL AND btrim(cron) <> '' AND interval_seconds IS NULL;`
- v0.1.6 was tagged but its release failed to build; use v0.1.7 and skip v0.1.6.
